name: chicken-freshness-logreg
how_to_predict: z = (x - scaler_mean) / scaler_scale; p = 1 / (1 + exp(-(intercept + sum(coef * z)))); tidak segar if p >= threshold

rel_computation.volt: V = raw * vref / 1023   (vref of the device, 5.0 V)
rel_computation.rs: Rs = RL * (VCC - V) / V   (V clipped at >= 0.01)
rel_computation.rs_air: median Rs of the baseline (empty box, lid closed): skip its last 10 s, then take the 60 s before
rel_computation.rs_sample: median Rs of the last 60 s of the sample (chicken in, lid closed)
rel_computation.invalid_if: fewer than min_points readings in a window, or any raw >= 1023 in the sample window
